name: PO issues vs delivered
query:
SELECT 
    po.name AS "Purchase Order:Link/Purchase Order:150",
    po.supplier AS "Supplier:Link/Supplier:200",
    poi.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:150",
    poi.item_name AS "Item Name:Data:200",
    poi.qty AS "Ordered Qty:Float:120",
    poi.received_qty AS "Received Qty:Float:120",
    (poi.qty - poi.received_qty) AS "Pending Qty:Float:120",
    po.transaction_date AS "PO Date:Date:120",
    po.schedule_date AS "Expected Delivery Date:Date:120",
    po.status AS "PO Status:Data:100"
FROM 
    `tabPurchase Order Item` poi
JOIN 
    `tabPurchase Order` po ON poi.parent = po.name
WHERE 
    po.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled', 'To Bill')
ORDER BY 
    po.schedule_date ASC;
